answer: Attestations arrive sealed. Each key posts a salted hash of its choices before the batch unseals; the reveal comes thirty minutes later and must match the ledger, or the 25 POA behind that key burns. Salts are per key, so a shared cache buys a farm nothing: copying after the unseal is copying a bid already seen. Fifty clones owe 400 independent checks at twelve minutes each, 80 hours an epoch, and keep 1,250 POA exposed to one slipped reveal. A sable coat hides fifty wearers as one shape, yet each still needs its own voyage across water, and an opal shows fire only to an eye that moves.
